label.selectFirst: Pick a column (only the front card of each is in play)
label.selectSecond: Pick a column whose front card makes 14

tutorial.board: The whole deck is dealt into 12 columns. Only the front card of each is in play; remove any two that add up to 14 (K+A / Q+2 / J+3 / 10+4 / 9+5 / 8+6 / 7+7).
tutorial.remove: Click one column, then a column whose front card makes 14 — both cards go. Suit does not matter, and the columns need not be adjacent.
tutorial.controls: The buttons below cover Undo, Give up and Reset.
tutorial.win: Clear all 52 cards to win. When no pair adds to 14 the game is lost — there is no redeal.

hint.removePair: Remove the two highlighted cards — they make 14
hint.none: No move to recommend right now
